summary.text: Saddam Salim is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 37, serving since 2024.
The district covers all of Fairfax City and Falls Church City and part of Fairfax County.
The Senate biography lists Saddam Salim's occupation as financial consultant.

paragraphs.text: The biography says Saddam Salim was born in Noakhali, Bangladesh.
It lists a master's degree in public administration from George Mason University.
The biography lists membership on the National Conference of State Legislators Technology and Communications Committee and the Information Technology Advisory Council of Virginia IT Agency.

Its honors include Legislator of the Year from the Virginia Professional Firefighters (2025), Alumni of the Year from George Mason University (2025) and Legislative Hero from the Virginia League of Conservation Voters (2025).
Saddam Salim serves on the Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources; Courts of Justice; Privileges and Elections; and Rehabilitation and Social Services committees.
